recommendation.name: Versioned Binary Forecast Aggregation and Evaluation Scope
core: Explicit versioned binary questions,event/cutoff/resolution identity and dependence groups
Unique forecaster roster,immutable revision parent chains and latest eligible selection
Equal arithmetic means and user-declared nonnegative normalized weights frozen before evaluation outcomes
Missing/abstaining/zero-weight accounting with no fabricated aggregate at zero denominator
Exact Fraction binary Brier0–1 and separately named doubled two-category0–2
Matched aggregate/individual/baseline evaluation; exact-probability decomposition and descriptive calibration
Dependency disclosure and explicit synthetic/LLM versus human-declared identities; no independence certification
recommendation.formula: p_pool=sum_i w_i*p_i/sum_i w_i over eligible non-abstaining participants; equal mode w_i=1
recommendation.scientific_limit: Correct pooling/scoring does not demonstrate crowd superiority,independence,causality or empirical forecasting skill. This editorial linear pool is not replication of advanced tournament aggregation.

supported_candidate: Offline declared binary forecast records and exact pooling/scoring
Precommitted fixed weights,missingness and matched denominators
experimental: Interpreting dependent/synthetic/LLM committees as useful real-world forecasts
unsupported: Automatic empirical superiority or iid significance

conventions: Retain #51 UTC-Z timestamps,versioned binary identities,cutoff-inclusive eligibility and named binary0–1/two-category0–2 scales; changes to51 contracts prohibited. No forced full-schema adapter.
Question definition hashes exclude subsequently supplied resolutions/outcomes. Weights and selection must not depend on outcome labels; label-flip control changes scores only.

Forecast revisions are one dependent history per question/forecaster,not separate voters. Late or outcome-informed revisions receive explicit rejection/exclusion and cannot replace earlier eligible revisions.

Latest eligible abstention withdraws that forecaster rather than silently restoring an older probability. Nonnegative weights renormalize over available non-abstaining entries; zero available weight is not_estimable.
Duplicate identities/versions,unknown references,broken hash parents,invalid probabilities and chronology reject structurally. Numeric agreement alone does not establish duplicate identity.
Dependency groups and kind declarations do not certify independent experts. No confidence intervals/effective sample size inferred from roster size.
Score resolved held-out test questions separately from train; compare model/individual/baseline on identical question/event IDs. Never learn weights from evaluation outcomes.
Exact identical-probability grouping gives Brier decomposition; coarse calibration bins are descriptive and must not be substituted into the exact identity. No small-N skill certification.
source_boundaries: Malone and Surowiecki are design/context sources; only official metadata/overviews inspected,not full algorithmic chapters.
Mellers2014 studies training,teaming and tracking. Advanced statistical aggregation is reported elsewhere; median team leaderboard scores differ from mean forecast probability pooling.
Paper0–2 scores and normalized0–1 binary decomposition must be explicitly scaled. First core is fixed-cutoff,event-level scoring,not daily/question-standardized tournament replication.
All tests/fixtures will be self-authored synthetic. Actual participant records need permission/provenance and separate empirical validation; no paper figures/body/data copied.
